long_biography.plain_text:
Travel entrepreneur Jeff Willner discovered that an efficient booking system could not replace reassurance. After an expensive online advertising campaign failed to produce the expected sales, he brought travel agents into Kensington’s model. Customers, local suppliers and agents could use the same system, combining immediate booking with someone available to explain unfamiliar journeys.

At the Royal Ontario Museum, Willner and his wife, Stacey Madge, helped fund the Dawn of Life gallery. Their gift supported a permanent exhibition of fossils tracing life before dinosaurs, including specimens from Canada’s Burgess Shale. He also chaired the museum’s governors, whose responsibilities include raising philanthropic support for its priorities.
